The support legs and structural beams of the machinery in the mid-ground appear somewhat indistinct and geometrically ambiguous. It is difficult to trace exactly how some components connect to the floor or each other, suggesting minor AI hallucination of complex mechanical structures.
The perspective of the conveyor belt seems slightly warped, with the railing thickness varying inconsistently as it recedes into the background.
